action_plan_position: Uses HIS 2014 figures (227,600 IB40 households; RM2,672 B40 mean; RM4,627 median) as the live 2026 baseline throughout
evidence_needed: DOSM HIES 2022 and a DOSM Indian-specific B40 household count for 2022
resolution_method: Recalculate against DOSM HIES 2022; retain the 2014 figures only as explicitly labelled historic MIB baselines
adopted_resolution: 2014 figures retained ONLY as MIB-era baselines with the year stated. Present-day statements use HIES 2022. Re-estimation of the Indian B40 household count is listed as validation item VAL-02.

item: Relative poverty position of the community
action_plan_position: Frames Indian poverty as the defining national deprivation case, implying the highest need
evidence_needed: DOSM Poverty in Malaysia 2022 ethnic breakdown
resolution_method: Disclose the full ethnic comparison and rebuild the justification on structural exclusion and adverse trend rather than on relative poverty depth
adopted_resolution: Proposal states plainly: Indian absolute poverty 5.4% (2022) is below Bumiputera 7.9% and above Chinese 1.9%, and rose from 4.8% in 2019. The case rests on the rising trend plus specific structural exclusions, not on being the poorest group.

action_plan_position: Approximately 6-7% of the national population
evidence_needed: DOSM Current Population Estimates 2026 with a citizen/total denominator statement
resolution_method: Adopt the DOSM figure and state the denominator
adopted_resolution: Approximately 6.5% (2024), declining from 6.6% (2023). Denominator (total population vs citizens) flagged as VAL-04.

action_plan_position: Implies selection and panel composition are the binding constraint; proposes Indian officers on SPA/JPA panels
mib_v2_position: Frames it as awareness and preparation
evidence_needed: JPA statements on application volumes and appointment success rates
resolution_method: Adopt the JPA-stated cause; redesign the programme around application supply
adopted_resolution: PRG-13 is redesigned as an application-pipeline programme (outreach, preparation, application completion) because JPA states non-Malay applicants have the highest appointment success rates but very low application volumes. Panel-composition measures are retained only as a transparency measure, not as the causal remedy.

action_plan_position: ~25,000 cases treated as a hard caseload; 100% clearance in 24 months
evidence_needed: JPN/Home Ministry caseload data; legal advice on citizenship discretion
resolution_method: Establish a verified caseload first; replace a clearance-percentage target with throughput and cycle-time targets
adopted_resolution: PRG-01 Deliverable 1 is a verified caseload baseline within 9 months. Targets become processing-time and resolution-rate targets. No clearance percentage is promised, because Article 15/16 citizenship decisions are a Ministerial discretion.

action_plan_position: 528 schools; maintenance RM30m (2024) to RM50m (2026)
evidence_needed: MOE administrative record of SJKT count and maintenance allocation history
resolution_method: Adopt the dated MOE-sourced count; disclose the variant and avoid stating a growth multiple
adopted_resolution: 528 schools / 78,501 pupils as at 31 May 2026 adopted; the 527 variant is disclosed in a footnote; no growth multiple is stated because the prior-year base is reported inconsistently (RM30m vs RM20m).

item: Nature of the MIB RM500 million instrument
action_plan_position: A five-year interest-free loan scheme, RM5,000 per household, 100,000 IB40 households
evidence_needed: MIB 2017 primary text
resolution_method: Inspect the primary MIB PDF and correct
adopted_resolution: MIB 2017 pp.41 and 112 establish a RM500 million PNB unit-trust SEED FUND providing matching booster units to IB40 savers. The loan characterisation is removed everywhere, and the derived 100,000-household Phase 1 target (CLM-036) is rejected with it. PRG-11 is rebuilt as a matched-savings instrument consistent with the actual MIB design.

action_plan_position: 1.5 billion AS1M units allocated to the Indian community, up to 30,000 units per investor; lapsed with no successor fund
evidence_needed: MIB 2017 primary text
resolution_method: Full-text search of the primary MIB PDF
adopted_resolution: Zero matches for the figure in the 172-page MIB 2017 PDF. The claim, the 'community has gone backwards on equity' narrative, and the Phase 3 '>=3bn units' target are all removed. Pillar 3 is rebuilt around household savings and asset accumulation, which the MIB does support.

action_plan_position: Within 10 years
evidence_needed: MIB 2017 primary text
resolution_method: Inspect primary source
adopted_resolution: MIB 2017 pp.33 and 40 both state within 5 years. Corrected to five years wherever the MIB target is described.

action_plan_position: Requests Phase 1 be funded 'within the existing Indian-community allocation (RM220 million in Budget 2026)'
evidence_needed: Budget 2026 supply documents
resolution_method: Verify at source; if unverified do not build a funding request on it
adopted_resolution: The RM220 million Indian-community line could not be substantiated; the figure surfaced in a Parliamentary-institution context. Only MITRA RM150m (2026) and SPUMI RM50m (2026) are used as verified existing allocations. Confirming the full existing Indian-community envelope is validation item VAL-03, and the proposal states that the Phase 1 request cannot be finalised until MOF confirms it.

item: Attribution of the '7 of 23 PTMI reforms' finding
action_plan_position: Cited four times as '(PEMANDU, 2024)' including in the executive summary
evidence_needed: The PEMANDU MITRA report itself
resolution_method: Inspect PEMANDU's published output
adopted_resolution: PEMANDU's published page confirms the engagement but not the finding; the figure is traceable only to a secondary academic paper. Retained once, in a footnote, attributed to the secondary source and phrased as reported. It is not used to carry any argumentative weight.

action_plan_position: Asserted as fact four times and used to justify safeguards
evidence_needed: MACC records or court outcomes
resolution_method: Verify; if unverified state as reported and never imply guilt
adopted_resolution: Retained once, in the governance-safeguards section, as a reported enforcement action with no assertion of guilt and no naming. Safeguards are justified on standing public-financial-management grounds rather than on the incident. Verification is item VAL-07.

action_plan_position: 6,590 approvals and 4,155 citizenships, used as proof the backlog is soluble
evidence_needed: National Registration Department records
resolution_method: Verify; otherwise qualify
adopted_resolution: Retained as a reported precedent with attribution qualified. It is not used to derive any throughput target for PRG-01. Verification is item VAL-06.

item: Matriculation sub-quota and Indian seat count
action_plan_position: A standing 3.72% sub-quota yielding ~1,116 seats; 1,537 Indian offers in 2025
evidence_needed: MOE matriculation intake statistics disaggregated by ethnicity
resolution_method: Verify; in the absence of MOE confirmation, state only the verified 90:10 framework and disclose the dispute
adopted_resolution: Two irreconcilable figures exist for the same quantity (1,116 asserted by an NGO; 1,537 asserted by Doc A) and neither is traced to MOE. The proposal states the verified 90:10 framework, records the dispute, and makes the first deliverable a published disaggregated intake series rather than a seat-count target.

action_plan_position: Placed inside Indian-specific passages, inviting the inference that 6,717 are Indian students
evidence_needed: The Star / FMT reports of 8 April 2026
resolution_method: Restate with the population scope explicit
adopted_resolution: Every use now reads 'all 6,717 candidates nationally, across all ethnic groups, who scored 10A or better in SPM 2025'.

item: The RM300 million 2025 entrepreneur financing package
action_plan_position: Stated as a deployed package of MITRA RM100m + SPUMI RM100m + BRIEF-i RM100m
evidence_needed: MITRA/TEKUN/Bank Rakyat disbursement records
resolution_method: Verify; exclude from any baseline until confirmed
adopted_resolution: Excluded from the MIB 2.0 existing-funding baseline. Difficult to reconcile with SPUMI's 2026 allocation of RM50 million being described as the highest ever. Verification is item VAL-10.

item: The RM2 billion dilapidated schools programme
action_plan_position: Cited adjacent to SJKT claims implying it is Indian-community funding
evidence_needed: MOE breakdown of the dilapidated-schools programme by school type
resolution_method: Establish the SJKT share; until then do not attribute
adopted_resolution: Treated as an existing NATIONAL programme. MIB 2.0 claims no part of it as community funding, and PRG-03's existing-funding assumption is explicitly flagged as provisional pending the MOE breakdown (VAL-11).

action_plan_position: 122,082 MITRA beneficiaries (2024) presented as a headline reach figure
mib_v2_position: Explicitly criticises counting beneficiaries as a measure of success
evidence_needed: MITRA unique-beneficiary data
resolution_method: Adopt Doc B's position; distinguish reach from unique beneficiaries throughout
adopted_resolution: Doc B's critique is accepted. The KPI framework distinguishes reach (episodes of service) from unique beneficiaries, and the costing model carries both a reach count and a unique-beneficiary count with an explicit overlap treatment (ASM-030).

action_plan_position: Explicit: 12 months to the next general election; 'one year earns the mandate, five more finish the job'; Phase 1 engineered for pre-election visibility
mib_v2_position: Chapters 7 and 8 are entirely political messaging and voter persuasion
evidence_needed: None - this is a document-standard question
resolution_method: Remove all electoral and partisan content from a Cabinet submission
adopted_resolution: All electoral sequencing, mandate language and voter-persuasion content is excluded. Phase 1 is justified on delivery-readiness grounds (measures requiring administrative rather than legislative action are sequenced first), which produces the same sequencing on a defensible basis.

action_plan_position: Three two-year phases
mib_v2_position: Two phases at Tab 1 (Years 1-2, 3-6); three phases at Tab 10 (1-2, 3-4, 5-6)
evidence_needed: None
resolution_method: Adopt three two-year phases per the locked brief and Doc B's own roadmap chapter
adopted_resolution: Three two-year phases adopted throughout.

action_plan_position: 4.5% by Year 2, 5.5% by Year 4, 7.0% by Year 6
evidence_needed: JPA headcount base and annual intake data
resolution_method: Recompute the required stock change and restate as a defensible range
adopted_resolution: 7% by Year 6 would require approximately 43,000 net additional Indian officers - rejected. Adopted target is a range of 4.2%-4.8% by Year 6, with the 7% MIB aspiration explicitly reset as a longer-horizon objective beyond this plan.

action_plan_position: 90% of IB40 children aged 4-6; at least 40,000 subsidised places, scaled from the 227,600-household denominator
evidence_needed: DOSM/MOE cohort data for Indian children aged 4-5 by household income
resolution_method: Rebuild the eligible population from cohort size
adopted_resolution: Recalculated eligible cohort is approximately 16,000 children aged 4-5 in low-income Indian households, so 40,000 subsidised places exceeded the population. Target restated as a participation rate rising to 80% of the eligible cohort by Year 6, i.e. approximately 12,800 children per year.

action_plan_position: At least 70% employed above RM2,672 per month
mib_v2_position: Employment must follow training; no threshold
evidence_needed: Current national minimum wage and DOSM median salary
resolution_method: Re-index to a current wage reference
adopted_resolution: RM2,672 (a 2014 B40 mean) is replaced by an indexation rule: employment at or above the prevailing national minimum wage plus 25%, restated annually, with the actual threshold published each year.

action_plan_position: 2% vendor participation share and RM100 million cumulative contract value for Indian-registered SMEs
mib_v2_position: Explicitly merit- and capability-based; no quota
evidence_needed: AGC advice on Article 8; Treasury procurement instructions
resolution_method: Adopt Doc B's position; convert the quota into a capability programme with measured participation
adopted_resolution: The set-aside and participation quota are rejected. PRG-10 delivers vendor certification, consortium formation and bid capability, with participation measured and published but not mandated. AGC clearance is listed as VAL-01.

action_plan_position: Zero IB40 households in extreme urban poverty by Year 6
mib_v2_position: Structured poverty graduation; no absolute target
evidence_needed: DOSM poverty definitions and a baseline count
resolution_method: Replace with a measurable reduction target on a defined measure
adopted_resolution: Replaced with: reduce absolute poverty incidence among Indian households from 5.4% (2022 DOSM basis) towards the pre-2019 level of 4.8% or below by Year 6, measured on the DOSM absolute poverty measure, with the target formally reset once the 2024 and 2026 DOSM ethnic breakdowns are available.

item: Legal status of the task force
action_plan_position: Legal successor to the MIB agenda; apex body over MITRA and PTMI, able to direct line ministries
mib_v2_position: Deliberately avoids new bureaucracy; ministries retain their responsibilities
evidence_needed: AGC advice; machinery-of-government precedent
resolution_method: Replace with a Cabinet-established coordinating body with defined terms of reference
adopted_resolution: 'Legal successor' and directive authority over ministries are removed. The Task Force is established by Cabinet decision as a coordinating, accountability and escalation body; each programme retains its accountable ministry and accounting officer. Doc B's principle that ministries keep their responsibilities is adopted.

action_plan_position: Not proposed
mib_v2_position: A designated Navigator for each participating household, with no volume, cost, staffing or owner
evidence_needed: Caseload benchmarks from comparable case-management programmes
resolution_method: Define caseload and cap coverage to a costed volume
adopted_resolution: Adopted at 150 households per navigator, scaling to approximately 400 navigators and roughly 60,000 households cumulatively over six years. 'Each participating household' is defined as households enrolled in the Household Progression Programme, not all Indian households.

action_plan_position: Not proposed
mib_v2_position: A national audit of temples and community assets covering land tenure, heritage and compliance
evidence_needed: Federal-state division of powers on land, local government and religious administration; Hindu-only scope conflicts with a Malaysian Indian blueprint
resolution_method: Narrow the scope, redesign it as multi-faith and deliver through state and institution-specific partnerships
adopted_resolution: Redesigned as a religion-neutral programme open to faith-based and community institutions serving Malaysian Indian communities, expressly including Hindu temples, mosques and surau serving Indian Muslim communities, churches, Sikh gurdwaras, Baha'i facilities and other eligible institutions. A common safety, accessibility and compliance track uses needs-based criteria and state, institutional and any applicable religious-authority consent. A differentiated temple and estate-legacy track documents tenure, relocation and registration cases for state referral rather than federal adjudication. Funding excludes religious practice and is limited to life safety, accessibility, compliance and documented public-interest community-service spaces.

action_plan_position: Not used
mib_v2_position: Three absolute guarantees: no child, no youth, no family
evidence_needed: None
resolution_method: Restate as qualified commitments consistent with Doc B's own Tab 6 caveat
adopted_resolution: Adopted as the narrative spine but restated as pathway commitments with defined, measurable service standards. Doc B's own qualification ('guarantees that Government will ensure a visible pathway exists') is brought forward into the commitment language.

action_plan_position: Chapter 8 is a direct political appeal to the PM
mib_v2_position: Tabs 7 and 8, approximately 4,900 words, are messaging, signature statements, speech drafts and voter persuasion
evidence_needed: None
resolution_method: Exclude entirely from the Cabinet submission
adopted_resolution: Excluded. The proposal notes only that a public communications plan will be prepared separately under normal government protocols and is not part of this submission.

action_plan_position: The community does not need a new blueprint, only an execution engine
mib_v2_position: Not another blueprint; a progression model
evidence_needed: None
resolution_method: Resolve in favour of the locked brief
adopted_resolution: MIB 2.0 is presented as a six-year national blueprint whose distinguishing feature is that it is delivery-instrumented. The substance of both drafts' argument (design was never the binding constraint) is preserved as the diagnosis.

action_plan_position: Documentation registry matures into the IB40 master database, every household named, located, income-assessed
mib_v2_position: One family profile; one household progression record
evidence_needed: Data-governance and privacy assessment
resolution_method: Separate the registries; require a privacy impact assessment
adopted_resolution: The citizenship/documentation caseload system and the household progression record are kept as separate systems with no automatic linkage. Enrolment in the progression record is voluntary and consent-based. A Data Protection Impact Assessment is a Phase 1 gating deliverable (PRG-16).

action_plan_position: Asserts 'nothing in this proposal competes with an existing initiative' without testing it
mib_v2_position: Asserts it organises rather than replaces existing programmes
evidence_needed: Programme-level mapping against national schemes
resolution_method: Conduct an explicit duplication test for every retained programme
adopted_resolution: Every retained programme carries a duplication assessment in PROGRAMME_REGISTER.csv. Four proposed measures were merged or removed as duplicative, and the proposal states which national programmes each measure runs on rather than beside.

action_plan_position: Not addressed
evidence_needed: Programme participation data
resolution_method: Model reach and unique beneficiaries separately
adopted_resolution: The costing model records reach by programme and a portfolio unique-beneficiary estimate with a stated overlap factor (ASM-030). The proposal never sums reach figures across programmes.
